title: Saffron Costs $15 Per Gram Because Harvesting Takes 55 Hours
closing: The price reflects painstaking hand labor, so a tiny amount carries hours of work.
question: Have you cooked with real saffron?

segments.say: Saffron costs $15 per gram. The price gap with ordinary spices is enormous.
Saffron tops the comparison at $15 per gram. Even the specialty foods shown cost less.
Saffron requires 55 labor hours per pound. Hand harvesting makes the price easier to understand.
